notes.title: Stones of Solace - Free on Steam - August 20th
notes.content:
Just a little announcement that upcoming label project Stones of Solace now has: 
[list][*] a release date (in only 2 weeks!)
[*] a Steam page
[*] and a price (FREE!)
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122880/Stones_of_Solace/?curator_clanid=33711478
More info on our site --> http://www.icewatergames.com/solace

(If you like the game and want to support the artists, the itch.io page (linked on our site) will have a pay-what-you-want option, too!)
